text:
Amelia (PM): heads up — I want to consolidate our client-facing error contract before the console rollout. rough proposal below, pls weigh in.
Raj (Eng Lead): +1 we need a small set of canonical buckets + machine codes. customers and SDKs should be able to branch on codes, not free text.
Lila (Console PM): can we also standardize the short UI copy? consoles currently show everything from raw json to vague banners. want predictable phrasing for the banner, tooltip, and docs.
Sam: smallest schema wins for SDK ergonomics. ideally: http_status, code, message, retry_after(optional), meta(optional map). don't force nested complexity.
Marta (SRE): telemetry requirement: every returned error must emit tags: error_bucket, model, region, route. sampling for noisy 429s. we also need a sandbox endpoint to replay different mappings.
Jordan (Designer): for UI copy: 2-line pattern: 1) short statement (what happened) 2) micro-action (what they can do now). use verbs, not tech nouns.
Amelia (PM): here's the bucket map I'm proposing (high-level):
- retryable_system -> transient infra issues, clients should retry with backoff (candidate HTTP 503/502)
- throttled_quota -> rate/usage limits, include retry_after when available (HTTP 429)
- bad_request -> validation or user input issues (HTTP 400)
- auth_failure -> token/permission issues (HTTP 401/403)
- terminal_error -> model/manifest not found, non-retryable (HTTP 404/410/500)
- safety_block -> content blocked, surface safe-friendly copy (HTTP 403 with safety code)
Raj (Eng Lead): prefer naming without underscore but fine. question: do we map 5xx to retryable_system always? some 5xx are terminal (model file corrupted). we need subcodes.
Sam: that's why machine codes are important: e.g. code: "retryable:gpu_evict" vs "terminal:model_missing". http_status is a transport-level hint, not the single source of truth.
Lila (Console PM): for the console banner and logs, we should show a human line mapped from the bucket not the raw code. e.g. throttled_quota -> "Request rate exceeded. Consider reducing batch size or request Dedicated capacity." keep it short.
Jordan (Designer): examples: banner short: "Request limit reached"; action line: "Reduce parallel requests or enable burst capacity." tooltip expands to detailed guidance + link to docs.
Marta (SRE): telemetry side: add metric labels: error_bucket, error_code, retryable(bool), sampled(true/false). we should avoid extremely high-cardinality meta fields — keep meta keys small and whitelisted.
Sam: SDKs should expose both code and a convenience enum: isRetryable(), isQuota(), isAuthError() — that helps app logic without string parsing.
Amelia (PM): sample error payload (draft) — feedback welcome:
```
{
  "error": {
    "http_status": 429,
    "code": "quota_project_monthly_limit",
    "bucket": "throttled_quota",
    "message": "Quota exceeded for project",
    "user_message": "You’ve hit your monthly request quota.",
    "hint": "Reduce batch size or request Dedicated capacity",
    "retry_after": 60
  }
}
```
Raj (Eng Lead): fine but rename user_message -> summary maybe. user_message sounds like we expect them to edit it. summary explains in-app copy intent.
Jordan (Designer): +1 "summary" reads better. "hint" should be optional and used for actionable steps only. avoid telling customers to contact support unless necessary.
Lila (Console PM): for rollout UX: console gets a preview flag that maps codes->badge/text. We'll ship docs with canonical phrasing. SDKs vX will map codes to enums. need migration plan for existing customers who parse messages.
Marta (SRE): ops playbook: when throttled_quota spikes > baseline, auto-open ticket to capacity team. include sample query for logs: `count_over_time(errors{bucket="throttled_quota"}[5m])`.
Sam: backwards compatibility: servers should still accept older client tolerances. plan: return both old raw_message and new structured error for 6 months. then remove raw_message after warning period.
Amelia (PM): rollout checklist draft:
- [ ] spec PR for contract + examples in api repo
- [ ] console feature-flag + preview environment mapping
- [ ] SDK releases (py/node/go) with enums and helper funcs
- [ ] telemetry pipeline: add error_bucket tag + dashboards
- [ ] docs + microcopy canonical list
- [ ] 6-week migration window + deprecation notices
- [ ] run internal canary with 10% of traffic, monitor regressions
Lila (Console PM): question: should we translate some buckets to different visual severity? e.g. throttled -> yellow banner, auth_failure -> red? we need consistent color semantics.
Jordan (Designer): yes: map to severity: info (blue), warning (yellow), critical (red). throttled_quota -> warning, auth_failure -> critical, retryable_system -> info if single request, escalate to warning if sustained.
Marta (SRE): operational alerting thresholds should be on error_rate by bucket and service. critical if auth_failure spikes (possible creds leak or deploy issue).
Raj (Eng Lead): implementation note: server libs should provide helper to build errors. sample builder pseudocode:
```
Err.build()
  .status(429)
  .code("quota_project_monthly_limit")
  .bucket("throttled_quota")
  .message("Quota exceeded")
  .summary("You’ve hit your monthly request quota.")
  .hint("Reduce batch size or request Dedicated capacity")
```
Sam: small ask: include a short stable numeric ID too (like 1001) so proxies/filters which only compare ints can still route. string codes for humans, int codes for low-level infra.
Amelia (PM): agreed — we'll add stable numeric code as well.
Marta (SRE): testing: create a synthetic workload to exercise each bucket. we need a replay harness so console can preview how banners would show for each error.
deploy-bot: deploy preview for api spec PR #172 deployed to preview-2 at 2025-06-04T16:12Z :rocket:
Amelia (PM): next steps: I'll open the spec PR with the draft payload above + enum list and migration timeline. please comment in PR, let's aim to cut SDK helpers in two weeks.
Raj (Eng Lead): I'll add server helpers and create the replay endpoint.
Lila (Console PM): I'll wire badge colors and short copy, and schedule a UX review with Jordan.
Sam: will prepare SDK change list and compatibility strategy.
Marta (SRE): will add telemetry tags and alert dashboard skeleton.
Jordan (Designer): will write canonical microcopy and example banners.
Amelia (PM): thanks all. if no objections by EOD Friday we'll start the PR merge path. :thumbsup:
